name: TransCentury Plc
source: TransCentury Plc audited summary consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2023 (FY2023 and FY2022 columns); TransCentury Plc audited summary consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, published on the NSE filing library (summary consolidated statement of financial position and summary cash flow statement). Figures are printed in KShs thousands and stored as absolute KES. The FY2024 balance sheet ties three ways: non-current plus current assets equals total assets (6,615,367 + 4,151,709 = 10,767,076), non-current plus current liabilities equals total liabilities (2,796,595 + 20,890,426 = 23,687,021), and total assets less total liabilities equals total equity (10,767,076 - 23,687,021 = -12,919,945), which also equals the closing balance on the statement of changes in equity.
